svg.title: Three piles of puzzles, and a mirror test
svg.desc: Puzzles are split into train (200, the teacher may look at failures), dev (120, the grader scores every candidate) and test (240 plus 240 mirrored twins, sealed until the final configuration is frozen). Each puzzle comes from a different game. Below, a training puzzle where Black mates with Nf2+ Kh4 Rh2# is shown next to its mirrored twin, where the board is flipped and colors swapped so White mates with Nf7+ Kh5 Rh7#. A model that understands the idea scores the same on both; a model that memorized published puzzles does not.

g.text: one puzzle per game, so no game shows up in two piles
